```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_xlsx("/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/BUILDS_AND_TECH (2).xlsx", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(df)<- c("name", "build", "tech", "numtech", "study")

counts_builds <- df %>%
  count(!!sym(colnames(df)[2]), name = "count") %>%
  rename(build = 1)
custom_colors <- c("#8da0cb", "#fc8d62", "#66c2a5")
label_map <- setNames(counts_builds$build, counts_builds$build)

max_y <- max(counts_builds$count)
ylim_top <- max_y * 1.15

plot_builds <- ggplot(counts_builds, aes(x = build, y = count, fill = build)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_map) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, ylim_top), expand=c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Genome build",
       y = "Studies") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0.5,1,0.5,0.5,"cm")
  )

counts_tech <- df %>%
  count(!!sym(colnames(df)[4]), name = "count") %>%
  rename(tech = 1)

label_map2 <- setNames(counts_tech$tech, counts_tech$tech)

max_y2 <- max(counts_tech$count)
ylim_top2 <- max_y2 * 1.15

plot_tech <- ggplot(counts_tech, aes(x = tech, y = count, fill = tech)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "1.0" = "1",
    "2.0" = "2",
    "3.0" = "3+",
    "3+" = "3+"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, ylim_top2), expand=c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Genotyping chips",
       y = "Studies") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0.5,1,0.5,0.5,"cm")
  )

plot_builds
plot_tech

# Directory containing the Excel file
outdir <- "/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/"

# ---- Save genome build plot ----
pdf(file.path(outdir, "plot_builds.pdf"), width=6, height=5)
plot_builds
dev.off()

# ---- Save technologies plot ----
pdf(file.path(outdir, "plot_tech.pdf"), width=6, height=5)
plot_tech
dev.off()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
snp_density <- read.csv(paste("/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/oahmed/gwas_perspective/fig2_data_limitations/data/snp_density_per_study.csv", sep=""), header=FALSE)

# Create a vector of matches: for each row of df find which snp_density row matches
match_idx <- sapply(df[[5]], function(x) {
  # find rows where either contains the other
  hits <- which(
    str_detect(snp_density[[1]], fixed(x)) |
    str_detect(x, fixed(snp_density[[1]]))
  )
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  return(hits[1])   # if multiple, take the first
})

# Extract column 2 from snp_density
df$snp_density_col2 <- snp_density[[2]][match_idx]

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# ---- Extract year from 'study' and prepare snp density ----
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # pull substring before first underscore (the year)
    year = str_extract(as.character(study), "^[0-9]+"),
    year = as.numeric(year),
    snp_density_numeric = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(snp_density_col2)),
    snp_density_millions = snp_density_numeric / 1e6
  )

# continuous year range
year_min <- 2008
year_max <- 2024
year_breaks <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 2)

plot_year <- ggplot(df, aes(
  x = snp_density_millions,
  y = year,
  color = as.factor(build)
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = 0.6) +   # ← transparency added
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "SNPs in GWAS summary statistic (millions)",
    y = "Year",
    color = "Build"
  ) +
  # X-axis extended slightly to avoid point cutoff
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08)),  # small left pad, bigger right pad
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
  ) +
  # continuous year axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(year_min, year_max),
    breaks = year_breaks,
    labels = year_breaks
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(size = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

plot_year


ggsave(
  filename = paste0("/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/fig2-panel_a_points_year.pdf"),
  plot = plot_year,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)


```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

############################################################
# 1. Make sure the tech column exists and is character
############################################################

df <- df %>% mutate(tech = as.character(tech))

############################################################
# 2. Clean + split the giant messy tech column
############################################################

clean_tech <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all(" and ", ",") %>%       # replace "and" with comma
    str_replace_all("\\(|\\)", "") %>%      # remove parentheses
    str_replace_all("the ", "") %>%         # remove leading 'the'
    str_replace_all("\"", "") %>%           # remove quotes
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%        # collapse multiple spaces
    str_replace_all("\\s*,\\s*", ",") %>%   # normalize comma spacing
    str_trim()
}

df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(tech_clean = clean_tech(tech)) %>%
  mutate(tech_list = str_split(tech_clean, ",")) %>%
  unnest(tech_list) %>%
  mutate(tech_list = str_trim(tech_list)) %>%
  filter(
    tech_list != "",
    !str_detect(tech_list, "^more$|more$|\\bmore\\b"),
    !tech_list %in% c("3+", "10+", "plus", "like 10+"),
    !str_detect(tech_list, "\\b(hrc|haplotype\\s*reference\\s*consortium)\\b"),
    !str_detect(tech_list, "\\b(1000g|1kg|one\\s*thousand\\s*genomes|1000\\s*genomes|thousand\\s*genomes)\\b")
  )

############################################################
# 3. Normalize common variants
############################################################

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    tech_norm = case_when(
      str_detect(tech_list, "immuno") ~ "ImmunoChip",
      str_detect(tech_list, "omni zh?onghua") ~ "OmniZhongHua-8",
      str_detect(tech_list, "gsa|global screening") ~ "GSA",
      str_detect(tech_list, "asa|asian screening") ~ "ASA",
      str_detect(tech_list, "omni1") ~ "Omni1",
      str_detect(tech_list, "omni2\\.5") ~ "Omni2.5",

      # EXOME-SPECIFIC (NO GENERIC 'exome' CATCH)
      str_detect(tech_list, "coreexome") ~ "CoreExome",
      str_detect(tech_list, "omniexpressexome") ~ "OmniExpressExome",
      str_detect(tech_list, "humanexome") ~ "HumanExome",
      str_detect(tech_list, "exome-8") ~ "Exome-8",
      str_detect(tech_list, "exome beadchip") ~ "Exome BeadChip",

      str_detect(tech_list, "hap550") ~ "HumanHap550",
      str_detect(tech_list, "hap300") ~ "HumanHap300",
      str_detect(tech_list, "affymetrix.*6\\.0") ~ "Affy 6.0",
      str_detect(tech_list, "affymetrix.*5\\.0") ~ "Affy 5.0",
      str_detect(tech_list, "axiom") ~ "Axiom",
      str_detect(tech_list, "\\b1m\\b|1m-") ~ "1M",

      TRUE ~ str_to_title(tech_list)
    )
  )

############################################################
# 4. Count chip frequency
############################################################

chip_counts <- df_clean %>%
  count(tech_norm, name = "count") %>%
  arrange(desc(count))

############################################################
# 5. Select top 10 for plotting
############################################################

top5 <- chip_counts %>% slice_head(n = 5)

############################################################
# 6. Plot
############################################################

plot_chips <- ggplot(top5, aes(x = reorder(tech_norm, count), y = count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1f78b4") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Genotyping Platform",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Top 5 Most Common Genotyping Platforms"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )



ggsave(
  filename = paste0("/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/chips.pdf"),
  plot = plot_chips,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)

```
